id: title:TueHaulund:dispatch comment bus notifications through a bound action

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a comment to the session recording player action configuration, warning against direct runtime invocation of actions to prevent React lifecycle errors ('is not mounted'). This could prevent runtime errors when editing comments after the comment model is unmounted.
review.reason: Adds a comment explaining that the action should be dispatched via connect or useActions, not called directly at runtime, to avoid 'is not mounted' errors.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the new action or relevant comments, so the actual behavior and benefit cannot be verified. The score is assigned based solely on the presence of the warning comment, not the implementation or outcome.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the definition of the `playerCommentModel` or the `playerCommentOverlayLogic`'s action creator, only the usage and the test. The score cannot be assigned without seeing the implementation of the new action and the complete context of the connection. observations.behavior: Adds a comment explaining that the action should be dispatched via connect or useActions, not called directly at runtime, to avoid 'is not mounted' errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the comment editing action to the session recording player, allowing comments to be saved and the comment state to be updated without depending on the comment model being mounted. This could prevent runtime errors when comments are edited after the comment model is unmounted.
